name: Savory Stuffing with Sausage, Leeks, Apples & Fresh Herbs

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 375°F. Grease a large (9 x 13-inch) baking dish with butter and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 stick celery
1 small pkg fresh sage
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Trim off the root ends and dark green tops of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut the leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Thinly slice crosswise and place in a medium bowl.
Quarter, core, and small dice apples. Add to the bowl with the leek.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the veggies and apple; set aside.
Once the skillet is hot, add sausage and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut (or tear) the bread into 1-inch pieces and place in the baking dish.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (1 lb) loaf French bread, sliced or unsliced

instructions.primary_message: When the sausage is done, using a slotted spoon, transfer to the baking dish with the bread. (Reserve skillet with drippings for the next step.)
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add additional butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and apple; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 6-7 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
While the veggies are cooking, pick sage leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the baking dish.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the baking dish.
When the veggies are done, add to the baking dish. Using tongs, toss to combine the stuffing.
Place eggs, broth, and spices in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the egg mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pour egg mixture over the stuffing and toss again to coat; spread out in an even layer. (The bread should feel wet - if it’s still a bit dry, add additional broth, ¼-cup at a time, until bread is soaked through. You may not need all of the additional broth.)
Dot the top of the stuffing with additional butter, then tightly cover the baking dish with aluminum foil.

Place baking dish in the oven and bake until stuffing is golden and dry on top, about 30 minutes. If the stuffing is still wet, remove foil and continue to bake, uncovered, until dry, 5-10 minutes more.
Remove stuffing from oven and let stand 5-10 minutes before serving.
